verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is the ability to declare a "test" incident to practice without affecting production. That is a practice or dry-run mode inside the live workspace, not an isolated sandbox environment or test account separate from production data. No sandbox workspace, test API environment, or isolated tenant for testing is documented, so the adjacent feature earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
